info.title: CAP-003 Payment Operations API — CHAPS Extensions (JRN-028)
info.description: Extensions to the CAP-003 (Payment Operations) API surface for CHAPS execution status and CoP check proxy. Served by SVC-009 (Domestic Payments) internally. Channels call the CAP-003 API; internal routing is an L3 concern. The CoP endpoint was introduced by JRN-002 (FPS); JRN-028 reuses it for CHAPS. New endpoint: CHAPS execution status lookup.

post.summary: Confirmation of Payee check (existing — extended to CHAPS)
post.description: Proxies a CoP request to the Pay.UK CoP service. Used for both FPS (JRN-002) and CHAPS (JRN-028) payments. Returns match result within 3,000ms. On timeout: returns unavailable result (GOV-003-R02 permitted). Phase: PH-078.

payment_rail.description: Payment rail — determines CoP scheme routing

chaps_intent_id.description: Required when payment_rail = chaps. Correlation ID for EVT-109 publication.

matched_name.description: Name as held at receiving bank (returned for partial_match if provided by scheme)

x-projection-note.description: Full Pay.UK response detail not surfaced to channel. Only result + matched_name projected.

408.description: CoP service timeout — treat as unavailable

503.description: CoP service unavailable — treat as unavailable per GOV-003-R02

get.description: Returns the CHAPSPaymentExecution (ENT-052) status for a given execution ID. Used by channels to display settlement status after PH-081. Response includes UETR for customer reference.

rejection_reason.description: ISO 20022 rejection reason code if status = rejected

x-projection-note.description: beneficiary_lei, sanctions_screening_reference excluded. purpose_code and payment_reference projected in full for customer transparency.

403.description: Execution belongs to different customer — cross-customer access blocked
